content.content:
User asks: "How old is each of the main cast members of the TV series Girls?" Need ages. As of now (2025-10-30). Main cast: Lena Dunham, Allison Williams, Jemima Kirke, Adam Driver, Zosia Mamet, James Cyr. Also maybe others: Jake Lacy? Actually main cast includes: Lena Dunham (born May 13, 1986), Allison Williams (born April 13, 1988), Jemima Kirke (born October 26, 1985), Adam Driver (born November 19, 1983), Zosia Mamet (born February 2, 1988), James Cyr (born March 20, 1990). Also "Megan" maybe? But main. Need ages as of today (2025-10-30). Compute.

Lena Dunham: born May 13, 1986. From 1986 to 2025 = 39 years. Since May 13 passed, she is 39.

Allison Williams: born April 13, 1988. Age 2025-1988=37, after April, so 37.

Jemima Kirke: born October 26, 1985. As of Oct 30, 2025, she turned 40 on Oct 26, 2025. So 40.

Adam Driver: born November 19, 1983. As of Oct 30, 2025, not yet birthday, so age 41 (2025-1983=42 but not yet turned 42). So 41.

Zosia Mamet: born Feb 2, 1988. Age 2025-1988=37, after Feb, so 37.

James Cyr: born March 20, 1990. Age 2025-1990=35, after March, so 35.

Check if main cast also includes "Megan" maybe? But main cast list from series: Lena, Allison, Jemima, Adam, Zosia, James. Could also include "Chris"? Actually "Megan" not. Also "Julianna" etc but minor.

Thus answer. Provide table.

content:
**Main cast of *Girls* (HBO, 2012‑2017) – ages as of 30 Oct 2025**

| Actor / Actress | Date of birth | Age on 30 Oct 2025 |
|-----------------|---------------|--------------------|
| **Lena Dunham** (Hannah) | 13 May 1986 | **39** |
| **Allison Williams** (Marnie) | 13 Apr 1988 | **37** |
| **Jemima Kirke** (Jessa) | 26 Oct 1985 | **40** (just turned 40 on 26 Oct) |
| **Adam Driver** (Adam) | 19 Nov 1983 | **41** (will turn 42 on 19 Nov) |
| **Zosia Mamet** (Helene) | 2 Feb 1988 | **37** |
| **James Cyr** (Thomas) | 20 Mar 1990 | **35** |

These ages are calculated from each performer’s birthdate up to the current date, 30 October 2025.
